paragraphs.speaker: host
paragraphs.text: Today: why work waits in line, in two minutes.

paragraphs.speaker: expert
paragraphs.text: A producer adds work. The queue holds it. A worker takes it out.

paragraphs.speaker: host
paragraphs.text: Why bother with the middle part?

paragraphs.speaker: expert
paragraphs.text: It absorbs spikes, and it lets a failed job retry later.
